criteria.label: CLOSE
similar: Oblique isometric projection and diagonal ground axes match.
Bridge and facility views use comparable pitch and elevation.
different: CANDIDATE frames a broader, flatter road-grid field.
REFERENCE crops more tightly into taller terrain relief.

evidence.observation: Angled bridge, river, and structures share a consistent oblique isometric view.
Comparable bridge angle and pitch, with more flat gridded ground in frame.
Raised rocky terrain occupies much of the tighter world framing.

criteria.label: RELATED
similar: Both feature a sinuous central channel crossed by an angled bridge.
The river remains integrated with industrial buildings and power routes.
different: REFERENCE water is narrow and muted between deep rocky banks; CANDIDATE water is flatter and bluer.
CANDIDATE ends with a broad flood basin, while REFERENCE ends with a narrow dry-looking channel.

evidence.observation: Narrow gray reflective channel curves through steep, densely textured banks.
Similarly curved channel uses saturated blue water and flatter contour-like banks.
Late-state view retains a narrow pale channel amid cracked terrain.

criteria.label: RELATED
similar: Both combine dark industrial metal and concrete with amber practical lighting.
Cyan and amber infrastructure accents remain legible against low midtones.
different: REFERENCE has richer rocky soil, foliage, and volumetric microtexture.
CANDIDATE relies more on flat gray road tiles and etched outlines, with less surface depth.

evidence.observation: Plant, bridge, rocks, foliage, and amber lights have layered, tactile shading.
Dark plant and amber route share the palette, but surfaces are flatter and strongly outlined.
Cracked soil and metallic tower retain dense material detail.

criteria.label: RELATED
similar: Both progress from a dark normal map to a warm stressed-state treatment.
Power infrastructure remains visible across the changing state panels.
different: REFERENCE stress is conveyed through cracked, desiccated ground; CANDIDATE heat is mainly a brown overlay.
CANDIDATE adds a large blue flood state absent from the displayed REFERENCE sequence.

evidence.observation: Late panel shows cracked brown terrain and a warning marker around persistent pylons.
The same industrial world shifts to a broad brown heat tint.
A wide bright-blue flood surrounds persistent buildings, pylons, and routes.
